meta.title: Recommended dose of fertilizer (RDF) for Maharashtra crops
meta.units: kg/ha of N, P2O5, K2O unless basis=per_plant. Where the source prints per-acre doses, the printed values are kept in as_given and the per-ha fields are derived (x2.471) and listed in derived_fields. Ranges are [min,max].
meta.how_to_use: Pick the entry for crop+season+condition; adjust N, P2O5, K2O separately by the soil-test class of that nutrient using soil_test_ratings.json (adjustment_rules). Prefer Maharashtra SAU entries; 'status' = complete | partial | conflict_flagged.

primary_source.name: MPKV Rahuri, Krishi Darshani 2026 (official annual diary / package of practices, Marathi; read from page images)
primary_source.note: Covers MPKV jurisdiction (Western + North Maharashtra, scarcity zone); Vidarbha (PDKV) and Marathwada (VNMKV) may differ - PDKV entries included where found; VNMKV and Dr. BSKKV (Konkan) packages not reached.

horticulture_meta.title: Recommended dose of fertilizer (RDF) - horticultural crops, Maharashtra
horticulture_meta.conventions: P = P2O5, K = K2O unless noted. Values from Krishi Darshani 2026 are printed per acre; *_kg_ha fields for those entries are DERIVED (x2.471) and listed in derived_fields; original values in as_given. Ranges given as [low, high]. null = not stated in source. DAT/DAS/DAP = days after transplanting/sowing/planting.
horticulture_meta.source_priority: MPKV Krishi Darshani 2026 (current official PoP) > MPKV research recommendations > ICAR institutes (DOGR, NRCG, NRCP) > NHB (secondary, national compiled)
horticulture_meta.unreachable: *.icar.gov.in (DOGR, NRCG, NRCP, NRCB, IIVR, CPRI, krishi.icar.gov.in) do not resolve from this machine; mirrors nrcgrapes.in and nrcpomegranate.in and the ICAR-DOGR/MANAGE book used.
horticulture_meta.status_values: complete = NPK + organics + split given; partial = some elements missing; conflict_flagged = unit/consistency problem, do not use without verification

crops.source_locator: PDF p131 (printed p112), 'bagayati kapus' (irrigated cotton) fertilizer section
crops.notes: Irrigated hybrids 40:20:20 kg/acre, improved varieties 32:16:16 kg/acre; Bt cotton gets 25% more than hybrid RDF = 50:25:25 kg/acre (stated in source). FYM ~8 cartloads/acre (unit not convertible). Drip alternative: same 50:25:25 kg/acre as water-soluble fertilizers in 14 weekly splits (1-21 DAP: 3 splits, 30% N/22% P/10% K; 22-66: 6 splits, 25/40/30; 67-77: 2 splits, 28/30/22; 78-98: 3 splits, 17/8/38). Sowing: 2nd fortnight May to 1st week June once temperature <35 C; not after 15 July.

district_gfr_icar_iiss.description: ICAR-IISS Bhopal bulletin 'District-wise general fertilizer recommendations for major crops in India' (STCR targeted-yield framework + SHC data 2023-25 + district yields). Maharashtra annexure. kg/ha. Earlier state-level GFR used by the bulletin: rice 100:50:50, wheat 100:50:50, sugarcane 340:170:170, kharif & rabi maize 120:60:40. '**' districts: rice data not part of nutrient balance computation. Wheat note: with FYM 5 t/ha reduce 20 kg N, 5 kg P2O5, 10 kg K2O.
district_gfr_icar_iiss.source_note: Copy hosted on vikalp.kisansarathi.in (iiss.icar.gov.in does not resolve from the research machine); publication date not printed - appears 2025-26. Values are much lower than SAU RDFs for wheat (50:30:20) - treat as a soil-fertility-adjusted district GFR, not a replacement for SAU RDF without review.
